text:
sasha: Kicking off canary deploy for rwinf-serving v3.2.1 into prod. Starting at 11:00 PDT. Holding traffic at 5% until smoke checks pass. See runbook link: /runbooks/backout-deploy-v3.md :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy rwinf-serving:v3.2.1 -> prod started. canary=5% | group=eu-us | id=deploy-1975234567
sasha: Quick checklist: metrics alerting on, dashboard pinned, canary SLOs are P50<100ms P99<250ms, 5xx threshold 1%. If anything crosses, follow backout steps below.
mike: Confirming: pin strategy is traffic-split rollback rather than image rollback, right? I want the exact commands if we abort.
elaine: Correct. Traffic pin + scale down canary pods. Backout steps in short (for quick paste):
```bash
# abort canary and pin previous version
redwood deploy traffic pin --service rwinf-serving --version v3.1.9 --force
redwood deploy scale --service rwinf-serving --version v3.2.1 --replicas 0
# start cleanup job to revert any config flags
redwood ops run revert-config --runbook backout-deploy-v3
```
mike: Good. Also add a quick DB migration check: abort if migrations incomplete > 0.
tj: Monitoring hook: I'll watch the canary viz channel. Alerting rule names: canary_5xx_rate, canary_latency_p99. If either fires, escalate to #eng-oncall and start backout. :alarm_clock:
ops-bot: metric check: canary_5xx_rate=0.4% | canary_latency_p99=220ms | errors=stable
sasha: Passing initial smoke. Hold 5 mins, then ramp to 25% if no regressions. 
deploy-bot: canary ramp scheduled: 5% -> 25% in 10m if smoke_ok. next_check in 300s
ops-bot: metric check (t+120s): canary_5xx_rate=1.6% (threshold breached), p99=310ms 
mike: :loud_sound: We breached 5xx threshold. Initiating abort now. Elaine, start backout steps and tag ops.
elaine: On it. Running abort sequence and pinning previous version.
```bash
# immediate abort sequence (run as ops)
redwood deploy traffic pin --service rwinf-serving --version v3.1.9 --reason "canary 5xx>1%" --ticket 1234
redwood deploy scale --service rwinf-serving --version v3.2.1 --replicas 0
redwood ops run revert-config --runbook backout-deploy-v3 --wait
# notify downstream teams
slack send --channel engineering --text "rwinf-serving canary aborted, traffic pinned to v3.1.9, investigating"
```
ops-bot: rollback job started id=rb-1975234599 | status=running
sasha: Thanks team. After backout: collect logs from canary pods, attach to ticket 1234, and schedule a postmortem for root cause and rollout gating.
mike: Agreed. I'll open the postmortem draft and assign owners.
ops-bot: rollback job completed id=rb-1975234599 | status=success | duration=63s
elaine: All steps complete. Traffic is pinned to v3.1.9 and canary pods are scaled to 0. Ticket 1234 updated with initial findings.
tj: I'll keep monitoring for any residual errors. Re-open if new alerts come in.
sasha: Good job. We'll re-run the staging replay and tighten the canary checks before next attempt. :thumbsup:
